New photo

Beta: Wrong jersey or an old photo? Send us a new one and we'll take care of the rest.

What we need

    Tip: ask a teammate to take it, holding the phone upright at chest height, a couple of steps back so you're in the frame down to your waist.

    Like this
    Top of the head to the waist, facing the camera, in this season's jersey. Plain light wall, even light, face in focus. Glasses are fine.
    Not like this

    We also can't use photos with other people in them, a cap or sunglasses, last season's jersey, or screenshots and photos of a photo.

    What we do with it

    We match the light and background to the studio set and frame every player the same way.
